kind: other
depth: deep
reason: deep-policy
-- base/main.tf --
resource "aws_cloudfront_distribution" "this" {
  dynamic "origin" {
    for_each = var.origin
    content {
      domain_name = origin.value.domain_name
      custom_origin_config {
        origin_protocol_policy = "https-only"
      }
    }
  }
}

variable "origin" {
  type = any
}
-- head/main.tf --
resource "aws_cloudfront_distribution" "this" {
  dynamic "origin" {
    for_each = var.origin
    content {
      domain_name = origin.value.domain_name
      custom_origin_config {
        origin_protocol_policy = "match-viewer"
      }
    }
  }
}

variable "origin" {
  type = any
}
